newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sanyo Sec capital adequacy ratio estimated 170 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo Sec capital adequacy ratio estimated 170 pct.

text.p: Sanyo Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday that its "capital adequacy" ratio at the end of September was estimated about 170 percent.

Japan's Securities and Exchange Law requires brokerages to disclose the ratio, which indicates their financial health. The ratio is that of net capital and latent profits on securities holdings against risk-weighted assets and potential losses from securities business.
A ratio of below 150 percent is considered an early warning level and if it falls below 120 percent, financial authorities can order brokers to improve their operations.
